justification: Documentation and .gitignore only. Two legacy script path fixes (non-functional LightRAG scripts). No business logic, no DB, no runtime code.

break_it.scenario: .gitignore negation for docs/intelligence-brief/** accidentally unignores other working files
break_it.how: .gitignore:365 — negation scoped to docs/intelligence-brief/ only. Verified with git check-ignore on adjacent dirs.
break_it.repro: git check-ignore docs/intelligence-brief/LEGAL_STRATEGY.md docs/qa/language-audit-2026-05-18.md — first not ignored, second still ignored

post_merge.secrets: No — .env.example contains placeholder values only, no real secrets
post_merge.manual_verify: Clone to new folder, follow SETUP.md, verify npm install and pytest pass
